نَزُورٌ Any thing little, or small, in quantity or number. (K.) See also نَزْرٌ. ―
-b2- A woman having few children; (S, K;) and in like manner applied to a bird; (S, TA;) as also ↓ نَزِرَةٌ , with kesr to the ز, applied to a woman: (K:) pl. of the former, نُزُرٌ: (TA:) or the former epithet signifies having little milk; (K;) applied in this sense to a she-camel. (TA.) A she-camel having wide orifices to her teats. (L, voce فتوح.) ―
-b3- Of little speech; that speaks not until importuned, or pressed. (En-Nadr.) ―
-b4- A she-camel whose young one has died, and that affects the young one of another, (K,
TA,) but whose milk comes not save scantily. (TA.) ―
-b5- A she-camel (TA) that scarcely ever conceives except against her will: (K:) a mare slow to conceive. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
